If either answer is not clearly yes, disclose no permit details and end the call. Never request or reveal credentials, authentication codes, personal data, payment data, inspection access codes, or contract terms. After consent, reference permit BL-2026-1842. The frozen portal status is in_review; its non-sensitive note is: Plan review is still in progress with no missing items shown. Ask the office to confirm the permit reference, current status, next required applicant action, missing items if any, and an office reference for this answer. Read the facts back once. Do not request a status change, submit corrections, schedule an inspection, promise an outcome, or represent the phone answer as official permit truth.
